migration.notes: Initial evidence-bounded candidate for benchmark-evidence integrity incident.

symptom: A report and closure path present a paired A/B performance verdict as pass even though the generator derives makespan from policy constants and synthetic operation counts; the real paired-analysis test retains an inconclusive verdict.

acceptanceRefs: ATM product goal: externally rerunnable A/B evidence must measure actual outcomes
ATM-GOV-0243 historical acceptance: paired A/B performance benchmark

publicSeam: The generated paired A/B report and ATM-GOV-0225 closure validation path.

stateTransition.from: Synthetic workload generator emits receipts with measured child-process durations.
stateTransition.to: Derived policy timings are used for makespan and a Markdown string check can accept a pass without validating measured receipts.

observedFactors: The child workload computes a deterministic checksum loop rather than executing ATM's two governed workflows.
Recorded command durationMs is not the source used by deriveTiming or buildSummary metrics.
The report validator checks prose values rather than recomputing from raw structured inputs.
A separate real-paired analysis test requires an inconclusive result pending supplemental samples.

upstreamDownstream: Audit other benchmark report validators for text matching where structured recomputation is required.
Trace benchmark summaries into task closure packets and product-proof claims.
samePolicyCallers: Inspect other consumers of policyProfiles, derived timing segments, and benchmark verdicts.
adjacentTransitions: Synthetic safety test to generated report to closure-validator pass transition.
sharedInvariants: Performance claims must be attributable to actual measurements and independently reproducible.

boundary: Verify the metrics consume measured treatment/control makespan rather than modeled values.
negative: Change or remove raw measurement receipts and prove the validator fails closed.
retry: Repeat the same sealed workload and preserve first-run failures separately from retries.
concurrency: Measure control and treatment under matched resource limits and declared contention.
mutation: Mutate synthetic policy constants while holding raw measurements fixed; a valid measurement-based verdict must not change.
propertyMetamorphic: Changing measured control/treatment durations should change recomputed metrics; changing report prose alone must never create a pass.
independentOracle: Require a custodian or independent executor to rerun the sealed protocol and attest the raw result digest.

disposition.rootCauseHint: Confirmed evidence-path mismatch: measured subprocess durations are recorded, but performance metrics are generated from modeled profiles and a report-text validator.
unknowns: Whether an external valid A/B run exists outside the inspected repository evidence.
Which sealed workload and independent-role specification should govern the replacement benchmark.
Whether the historical report numbers were intended as simulation-only or were interpreted as real rollout evidence by downstream consumers.
